rights_classes.meaning: Public metadata and short derived facts only; exact publication terms still apply.
ODbL material remains separately attributed with extract lineage.
Use only after exact owner, licence, access class, version and redistribution rights are pinned.
Minimized, permitted observation may validate a claim but cannot be mirrored as a dataset.
Authenticated CIP, account, personal, property, owner and query material remains gated or external.

sources.production_scope: A successful permitted and pinned operator observation may validate the stated four-digit postcode and locality or zone at observed_at. The FAQ is not a complete bulk assignment release, postal perimeter, complete history, stable public API or redistribution licence.

The page may validate one branch address and its displayed NNNN-NNN value at observed_at. It does not document a nationwide extended-code schema, mapping to the four-digit postcode, CIP relation, postal polygon, history, bulk API or reuse permission.

CIP may be used only for a permitted purpose with account-holder authority or another lawful basis, data minimisation, access control, retention and exact operator terms. The public portal description supplies no public CIP rows, coordinates, postcode mapping, building crosswalk or redistribution right.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union / Cabo Verde postal administration
sources.production_scope: The April 2014 sheet establishes dated formatting and coding context only. It is not a current assignment database, geometry file, complete history, CIP mapping, address dataset, delivery guarantee or blanket republication permission.

The August 2026 length table supports a four-digit public postcode format. It supplies no assignment rows, operator extended-identifier or CIP mapping, postal geometry, address data, building relation or bulk reuse right.

sources.provider: Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território (INGT)
sources.production_scope: Every selected resource requires exact owner, licence, access permission, version, coverage, CRS, axis order and digests. Catalog visibility, a viewer or service capability is not postal authority or blanket redistribution permission.

sources.provider: Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território (INGT)
sources.production_scope: A permitted pinned layer can supply administrative or toponymic context with service version, layer, CRS, validity and digest. It cannot supply a postcode assignment, official postcode surface, CIP link, delivery proof or exact building relation.

sources.provider: Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território (INGT)
sources.production_scope: A cadastral parcel or building can be used only from a rights-cleared exact artifact with version, geometry provenance, privacy review and a stable explicit address or CIP relation. Programme descriptions supply no reusable nationwide crosswalk, owner publication right or postal assignment.
Use only in a separately attributed ODbL partition with exact extract, timestamp and lineage. Community data is not Correios, UPU, INGT, cadastral or exact CIP-address-building authority.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned postcode, object type, locality or zone, observed time, validity and authority.
Operator-published NNNN-NNN value retained separately until a current schema and mapping are pinned.
Permitted authenticated CIP and georeference retained in a gated purpose-limited partition.
Exact rights-cleared operator surface explicitly bound to the same postcode, object type, edition and validity.
Optional non-canonical surface with permitted inputs, method, uncertainty, exclusions, topology, time, version and digests.
Island, municipality, parish, zone, city, town, place and neighbourhood identity and permitted geometry kept separate from postal assignments.
Rights-cleared addresses, parcels and buildings plus stable explicit relations, with private attributes removed.
OSM roads, places, addresses and buildings in a separate ODbL-compatible validation partition.
CIP accounts, recipients, households, residents, owners, titles, correspondence, queries, credentials and security-sensitive features.
